from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit
import hashlib
import json
import re

base = 'https://www.nrc.no/tenders'
source = Path('products/distribution/nonprofit-spreadsheet-paid-call/nrc-tenders.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '8a77082f1874007d50d0ee2704941a394557bab2e5a3ad674b766be296f33784', 'Capture differs from FETCH receipt'
pattern = re.compile(r'spreadsheet|excel|csv|tabular|data quality|data cleaning|data reconciliation|reporting data|terms of reference|invitation to bid|request for (?:proposal|quotation)|call for tender', re.I)

class TenderLinks(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.current = None
        self.candidates = []
        self.checked = 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.current = (dict(attrs).get('href') or '', [])

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.current is not None:
            self.current[1].append(data)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or self.current is None:
            return
        href, parts = self.current
        self.current = None
        label = ' '.join(' '.join(parts).split())
        if not href or href.startswith('#') or not label:
            return
        target = urlsplit(urljoin(base, href))
        if target.scheme != 'https' or target.netloc not in ('www.nrc.no', 'nrc.no'):
            return
        self.checked += 1
        match = pattern.search(label) or pattern.search(target.path.replace('-', ' '))
        if match:
            entry = {'label': label[:240], 'url': urlunsplit((target.scheme, target.netloc, target.path, '', '')), 'matched_phrase': match.group()}
            if entry not in self.candidates:
                self.candidates.append(entry)

screen = TenderLinks()
screen.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
screen.close()
result = {'source': base, 'receipt': 'TASK-179516556100', 'source_sha256': digest, 'first_party_link_labels_checked': screen.checked, 'matches_total': len(screen.candidates), 'matches': screen.candidates[:20], 'coverage': 'Static first-party link labels and paths in one saved buyer page. Unlinked text, external portals and dynamically rendered notices fall outside this screen. Matches are leads only. Verify live paid scope, deadline, response terms and acceptance on the source before preparing a sample.'}
output = source.with_name('nrc-tender-link-screen.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
